consumer_rights: Every customer is entitled to test hallmarked gold jewellery at any BIS-recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centre (AHC) upon paying a statutory consumer testing fee of ₹45 per article.

If the jewellery is found to be of lesser purity than stamped, the jeweller is statutorily liable under BIS Hallmarking Regulations 2018 to refund the customer twice the shortage amount and reimburse testing charges.
Mandatory hallmarking is in effect across 343+ designated districts in India under the Quality Control Orders issued by the Department of Consumer Affairs.
